title: Manager, Product Development
description:
Manager, Product Development (SunPass Program Lead)

  • Responsible for managing the lifecycle of SunPass products, solutions, and applications, ensuring they meet business requirements and align with the SunPass Operations roadmap.
  • Oversees product development activities, reporting standards, and operational governance while coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, customer-focused solutions.
  • Acts as a liaison between SunPass Operations, Toll Operations leadership, and technical teams to ensure timely delivery, continuous improvement, and compliance with established standards.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Product Development & Delivery

  • Manages research and development activities related to the design, enhancement, and qualification of SunPass products and solutions.
  • Works with cross-functional teams to ensure fulfillment of product requirements and transition products from development to commercialization.
  • Assists in determining product delivery and deployment schedules for new releases, feature updates, and maintenance cycles.
  • Acts as a technical consultant to the SunPass Operations team, leading testing and evaluation of innovative technologies.
  • Ensures technology and product specifications align with SunPass business objectives.
  • Oversees product delivery, managing schedules and tasks related to all aspects of product development.

Operational Governance & Reporting

  • Develops and maintains a centralized inventory of SunPass products, solutions and applications.
  • Captures and tracks SunPass Operations initiative updates in compliance with reporting standards.
  • Monitors input from all business units to ensure products meet functional and performance requirements.
  • Identifies opportunities for improvement and lifecycle replacement needs; prepares documentation and summaries for leadership visibility.
  • Collaborates with Toll Operations Business Intelligence team to develop dashboards and reporting tools for program performance monitoring.
  • Ensures Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are created and maintained, establishing a lifecycle process for updates.

Strategic Support & Emergency Response

  • Gains detailed knowledge of all facets of SunPass Operations to support decision-making and implementation of initiatives.
  • Serves in times of emergency to support state response efforts and ensure continuity of operations.

Education:

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Operations Management, Project Management or other related field.

Experience:

  • A minimum of 7 years of tech industry, product engineering, operations, technology integration, or other related work experience.
